risk_report.rationale: The incident report indicates a patient experienced life-threatening complete atrioventricular block following an unflagged ventricular tachycardia episode, requiring emergency resuscitation. The device-side confidence log for the exact episode window was not retained, but the hospital records confirm the event. This may trigger obligations under EU MDR Annex I, Chapter II, Section 17.4 regarding minimum IT security requirements and software development lifecycle. Additionally, it requires review under ISO 13485 Clause 7.5.1 for control of production and service provision, including labeling and packaging controls. The incident also falls under the EU MDR Article 83(1)-(2) post-market surveillance system as a proportionate risk class device event.
